# Modular Compliance

> Modular Compliance, by Instilligent Limited (NZ). NZ-built compliance register and workflow tool that maps legislation into structured frameworks, controls and tasks. Day-to-day compliance work is done by people; the tool keeps the record.

## About

Modular Compliance is a NZ-built register and workflow tool. It maps legislation into structured frameworks, controls and tasks — populated from AI-generated and partner-supplied templates that customers review and adapt as their starting point. Customers remain responsible for template content accuracy and applicability. The system records who completed what and when, captures policy and framework terms acceptance with an audit trail, surfaces overdue tasks on a dashboard, and stores supporting evidence and documents.

Compliance work is done by people; Modular Compliance keeps the record.

## Pricing (NZD, excluding GST)

- Starter — NZ$199/month + GST: up to 5 users, up to 2 compliance frameworks, 5 GB document storage, email support.
- Professional — NZ$499/month + GST: up to 25 users, up to 5 compliance frameworks, 25 GB document storage, REST API access.
- Enterprise — contact us for pricing: unlimited users, as many compliance frameworks as you need, SSO integration (SAML 2.0 & OIDC).
- Optional add-ons: build-your-own custom modules NZ$49/month for the first and NZ$25/month each additional; extra users NZ$25/user/month (Starter) or NZ$15/user/month (Professional); extra document storage NZ$5/GB/month.
- Register for Starter or Professional on the app (https://app.modularcompliance.com/register). This marketing site does not take card payment. Enterprise is by enquiry — email info@instilligent.com.

## Platform capabilities

- Compliance register: legislation mapped into frameworks, controls and tasks
- Multi-framework support (create, clone and adapt frameworks; custom frameworks supported)
- Configurable compliance task workflows
- Completion records: who completed what and when, with audit trail
- Policy and framework terms acceptance capture with audit trail
- Compliance dashboards (query-on-load, including overdue-task visibility)
- Evidence collection and document management
- Incident register with severity tracking
- Role-based access control
- SSO integration (SAML 2.0 & OIDC) — Enterprise tier
- REST API access — Professional tier and above

## Modules (framework template libraries — 9 active)

Each module is a seeded template library of obligations, controls and tasks — a starting point that customers review and adapt. Machine-readable inventory: https://modularcompliance.com/modules.json

1. Health & Safety — framework and task templates for workplace health and safety obligations (NZ Health and Safety at Work Act 2015)
2. Employment & HR — templates covering employment agreements, leave, termination procedures, record-keeping and good faith obligations (NZ Employment Relations Act 2000)
3. Privacy & Cybersecurity — NZ Privacy Act 2020 obligations register: IPP self-assessment (Information Privacy Principles), breach-response checklist, security controls register, policy library
4. Privacy & GDPR — data protection framework templates covering consent, breach response and data subject request obligations
5. Quality — quality management templates: policy, processes, audits and corrective action
6. Food Safety — HACCP-based food safety checklist and documentation templates
7. Body Corporate — task and documentation templates for body corporate governance obligations
8. Maritime — maritime safety documentation and checklist templates
9. Environmental — environmental management templates: policy, aspects and impacts, waste, emissions, resources and spill response
